title: Cohen--Macaulayness of $\mathrm{Inc}(\mathbb{N})$-Invariant Chains of Edge Ideals
summary: Let $(G_n)_{n\ge n_0}$ be a family of graphs on $[n]$ whose edge ideals $I_n\subseteq R_n=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ form an $\mathrm{Inc}(\mathbb{N})$-invariant chain, $I_{n+r}=\mathrm{Inc}(\mathbb{N})_{n,n+r}(I_n)$ for $n\ge n_0,\ r\ge0$. We determine which pairs $(n,r)$ make $R_{n+r}/I_{n+r}$ Cohen--Macaulay, for five classical families: line graphs $L_n$, complements of line graphs $L_n^c$, complete graphs $K_n$, cyclic graphs $C_n$, and complements of cyclic graphs $C_n^c$.
